name: Brasslight Slots: Casino Games
description:
Brasslight Slots is a cosy casino slots game full of cats. Spin a 5-reel slot with 243 ways to win, watch ginger, grey and white cats line up, and celebrate every big win. Virtual coins only, no real money.

SPIN WITH THE CUTEST CATS
• 5 reels, 3 rows and 243 ways to win on every spin.
• Heart-eyes cat wilds, crowns, fish, paws and balls of yarn.
• Big Win and Mega Win celebrations with confetti and counting coins.
• Turbo and Auto spin for when you want to play faster.

YARN PICK BONUS
Land three balls of yarn to open the Yarn Pick bonus round. Tap the yarn to find three hidden prizes worth up to 25 times your bet.

DAILY PURR-IZE WHEEL
Spin the prize wheel once a day for coins or gems. Come back on consecutive days to build your 7-day login streak.

LEVEL UP
Every spin earns experience. Each new level pays out coins and gems, and climbing the levels unlocks bigger bets.

A WARM WELCOME
New players start with 5,000,000 coins and 50 gems. Play as a guest, or sign in with Google for a bonus.

YOUR GAME, YOUR WAY
• Sound effects, music and haptics you can switch on or off.
• Optional reminders when your daily wheel is ready.
• No ads and nothing to buy.

FOR ADULTS, FOR FUN
Brasslight Slots is intended for an adult audience (18+). It is simulated gambling: it offers no real-money gambling and no opportunity to win real money or prizes. Coins and gems have no monetary value and cannot be bought, sold or cashed out. Practice or success at social casino gaming does not imply future success at real-money gambling.
